what: With the Hero held fixed, the center picture column (left 40vw · width 41.14vw) unfolds to 100vw over one screen of scroll with no curve — after 20px of scrolling, the logo cells and menu cells on both sides slide 50% outward over .5s and disappear. Once fully open, from 1.5 screens to the end of the track the picture inside the column sweeps from object-position 50% 35% to 50% 100%, all the way down.

options.from: Column starting width (vw), default 41.14 — also the css --fx-from
options.left: Pillar initial left (vw), default 40 — also the --fx-left in css
options.pan: Sweep end vertical position (%), default 100 — 0 means no sweep
options.dur: Time (s) for the sides to drop away, default .5 — 0 means instant

use:
Logo
Menu
note: The track (pinned element) must be taller than the screen for a pin range to exist — in the original, after the 100vh hero the about section overlapped upward with margin-top −250vh, so a white card passed over the same column. With page scroll like Locomotive, put data-fx-scroller on the panel.

from.where: index.html .hm-intro (hand-drawn map column + wordmark on the left and menu on the right) — original p-top-fv: width 100vw · left 0 · margin-left 0 scrub (fv top top → bottom top), is-active (top+=20px) with .5s on both sides, p-top-fv__img img objectPosition 50% 100%
